panels.description: Current size of the temporary memory index (datomic_transactor_memory_index_mb_hi, from the metrics-callback). Datomic doesn't report memory-index-max / memory-index-threshold as runtime metrics, so start.sh reads them from config/transactor.properties and passes them to the exporter as datomic_transactor_memory_index_max_mb / _threshold_mb, once per transactor process.
